coordinate_convention: WGS84 (EPSG:4326) latitude and east-positive longitude in -180..180.
footprint_definition: Square footprint of half-width 0.25 degrees (about 56 km N-S full width, 56*cos(lat) km E-W) centred on the site. Smaller than the Mars footprint because Earth analog field sites are typically a few tens of km across; terrain statistics are computed on a grid block-averaged to the MOLA 16 ppd cell size (~3.7 km, separately per axis) so they are comparable to the Mars values.

candidates.name: McMurdo Dry Valleys - University Valley
candidates.description: University Valley, a high-elevation (~1700 m) valley in the Dry Valleys with some of the coldest and driest permafrost soils on Earth: dry permafrost over ice-cemented ground.
known_analog_use: Dry permafrost over ice-cemented ground studied as a Mars analogue (Marinova et al., 2022)

candidates.name: Summit Station, Greenland Ice Sheet
candidates.description: Summit of the Greenland Ice Sheet. Along the ice-sheet margin, surface melting exposes old ice with a visible stratigraphy of variable dust content.
known_analog_use: Greenland Ice Sheet margin ice studied as an analogue for the north polar layered deposits (Yoldi et al., 2020)

candidates.name: Amundsen–Scott South Pole Station
candidates.description: Amundsen–Scott South Pole Station, Antarctica. No approved source describes this site.

candidates.name: Painted Desert
candidates.description: Painted Desert, Arizona, with wide clay-bearing horizons interspersed with iron oxide/hydroxide and carbonate units.
known_analog_use: Field site compared with Mawrth Vallis phyllosilicate and sulfate assemblages (Bishop et al., 2025)

candidates.name: Jaroso Ravine
candidates.description: Ravine in the Jaroso hydrothermal system, SE Spain, with extinct iron-rich hydrothermal chimneys studied as Mars analog samples.
known_analog_use: Fossil hydrothermal vent analysed as a Mars analog sample (Demaret et al., 2022)

candidates.name: Liwa Desert
candidates.description: Liwa Desert, United Arab Emirates. Lithified aeolian deposits in the UAE were used as analogues for calcium-sulfate-cemented Martian dunes.
known_analog_use: UAE lithified aeolian deposits used as analogues for the Stimson formation, Gale crater (Krishnamoorthi et al., 2025)

candidates.name: Sudbury impact structure
candidates.description: Sudbury impact structure, Canada, known for the Sudbury Breccia; ranked among terrestrial impact sites used as planetary field analogs.
known_analog_use: Ranked among terrestrial impact sites as field analogs (Lambert & Reimold, 2023)
Robotic sample-return analogue deployment (Moores et al., 2012)

candidates.name: Yilgarn Craton salt lakes
candidates.description: Shallow ephemeral, mildly acidic salt lakes on the Yilgarn Craton, Australia, over paleodrainage channels; their sediments hold halite and gypsum.
known_analog_use: Sediment microbiology of acidic salt lakes as terrestrial analogs to ancient Mars (Aerts et al., 2019)

candidates.name: Granby tuff
candidates.description: Hydrothermally altered basaltic flows, dikes and tuffs at Granby, Massachusetts, whose Fe-rich vermiculite clays are the best spectral analogy found for the clays of Oxia Planum.
known_analog_use: Spectral analogue for the Fe/Mg clays of Oxia Planum (Krzesińska et al., 2021; Bultel et al., 2022, 2025)

candidates.name: Galena Creek Rock Glacier
candidates.description: Ice-cored Galena Creek Rock Glacier, Wyoming, with a boulder debris layer over ice; radar-surveyed to image its internal structure.
known_analog_use: Ground-penetrating radar surveys of ice and debris structure (Petersen et al., 2019; Aguilar et al., 2024)

candidates.name: Haughton impact structure
candidates.description: Haughton impact structure (Arctic Canada), where gullies formed through the melting of snow and ground ice are studied for their implications for gullies on Mars.
known_analog_use: Gully formation studied as an analogue for Martian gullies (NASA NTRS, LPSC 2020)

candidates.name: Channeled Scablands
candidates.description: Flood-carved landscape on the Columbia Plateau, eastern Washington, where megafloods stripped the loess and exposed volcanic basalt.
known_analog_use: Compared with Martian outflow channels such as Ares Vallis (NASA)

candidates.name: Río Tinto
candidates.description: Río Tinto basin, Spain: an acidic river whose sulfide bioleaching products resemble the sulfate and iron oxide deposits of Mars; a NASA drilling test site.
known_analog_use: Life-detection Mars Analog Project drilling tests (NASA Ames, 2015)

candidates.name: Lake Salda
candidates.description: Lake Salda, Turkey: a terrestrial analog for the paleolake in Jezero Crater, hosting active, subfossil and fossil hydromagnesite microbialites.
known_analog_use: Analog for the Jezero Crater paleolake (Gunes et al., 2024)

candidates.name: Dalangtan Playa
candidates.description: Dalangtan saline playa in the hyperarid Qaidam Basin, Tibetan Plateau, with Mars-like salts (magnesium sulfates, chlorides, perchlorates) and polygonal landforms.
known_analog_use: Mars analog site studied since 2008 (Kong et al., 2018)

candidates.name: Holuhraun lava field
candidates.description: Lava flow field of the 2014–2015 fissure-fed Holuhraun eruption, with lava–water interactions; a terrestrial analog for volcanic terrains in Elysium Planitia.
known_analog_use: Analog for volcanic terrains in Elysium Planitia (Voigt et al., 2025)
Rover and helicopter mission field test, 2022 (Gwizd et al., 2024)

candidates.name: Adventdalen delta, Svalbard
candidates.description: Adventdalen fjord-valley, Spitsbergen, whose Holocene fill includes a Gilbert-type delta and permafrost with excess ground ice.
